description: Treasury-strength reports for DeFi protocols and DAOs (Aave, Sky, Compound, Lido, Uniswap, Yearn, GMX and more): net realizable treasury after realization haircuts, liquid runway against approved spending, obligations, stress resilience, peer ranking and governance controls, with every figure cited. POST /v1/tcs6/score with an {entity_id} and get the full report as one JSON object; POST /v1/tcs6/entities lists the covered protocols. Deterministic between 12-hour refreshes. Research score, not investment advice. Pay per request in USDC; no account, no API key.

entity_id.description: Registry id from POST /v1/tcs6/entities, e.g. compound, maker-sky, aave.

outputSchema.description: For POST /v1/tcs6/score, a JSON object (schema tcs-6-paid-response/1.0) with analysis_status, headline (gross and net realizable treasury), overall_score, six dimensions with metrics and rationale, hard_gates, risks, data_gaps and a source_manifest. POST /v1/tcs6/entities returns {service, method_version, count, entities[]} with each protocol's latest score. Errors return a JSON object with an error field (HTTP 400 for unknown entity_id or malformed input). Published schema: https://raw.githubusercontent.com/organiccryptoyyc/pocket-agentic-services/main/treasury-capital-score/openapi.json

responseSummary.note: Abridged; captured on Pocket MainNet 2026-10-03. Full sample: https://github.com/organiccryptoyyc/pocket-agentic-services (treasury-capital-score)
